## Summary

Fixes #1634 and the follow-up regressions reported in PR comments, including exported Windows runtime reports where breaker bullets detonated but no shrapnel appeared.

This PR keeps the breaker-bullet behavior intact while hardening the runtime paths that regressed during review:

- Breaker bullets detonate 95px before walls and when an alive enemy with clear line of sight enters the forward shrapnel cone after a 40px arming distance.
- The shrapnel cone was widened to 45 degrees half-angle so the proximity fuse helps hits through the future fragment sector.
- Direct weapon-spawned projectiles, including PM `Bullet9mm.tscn`, are freed normally and cannot contaminate `ProjectilePoolManager` pools.
- Pool-created bullets, shrapnel, and breaker shrapnel are explicitly marked as pool-managed before they are allowed to return to the pool.
- Pool warmup, returns, and checkout now reject duplicate, invalid, active, or unmanaged projectile references.
- Enemy projectile pooling is limited to generic `Bullet.tscn`, so specialized enemy bullet scenes are not replaced by pooled generic bullets.
- Breaker shrapnel spawning now survives pool misses and missing fallback scenes without crashing.
- C# PM/Bullet9mm breaker detonation now uses `ProjectilePoolManager.get_breaker_shrapnel()` before falling back to direct scene instantiation.
- Checked-out pooled bullets, shrapnel, and breaker shrapnel are reparented into `get_tree().current_scene`; returned projectiles move back under pool containers.
- Pooled breaker shrapnel activation now applies position, direction, source id, damage, randomized speed, and a final deferred collision-enable after prior deferred disables.
- `SceneLoader` now uses `ResourceLoader` with `PackedScene` type hints for threaded and fallback scene loads, avoids Godot 4.3 sub-thread loading for exported scene transitions, and stops polling immediately after fallback.
- The branch has been merged with upstream `main` at `570daf75`; PR conflicts are resolved on head `5ce81c92`.

## Files changed

- `scripts/autoload/projectile_pool_manager.gd` - explicit pool ownership, warmup fix, duplicate-return protection, safer checkout/recycle/reparent logic
- `scripts/projectiles/bullet.gd` - managed-only pool return, direct-spawn cleanup, breaker arming/cone behavior, safer breaker shrapnel fallback and atomic pooled shrapnel activation
- `scripts/projectiles/shrapnel.gd` - managed-only pool return and deferred-safe collision state for reused pooled fragments
- `scripts/projectiles/breaker_shrapnel.gd` - managed-only pool return, atomic activation parameters, and final deferred collision enable for reused pooled breaker fragments
- `scripts/autoload/scene_loader.gd` - export-safe `ResourceLoader` scene fallback for `THREAD_LOAD_INVALID_RESOURCE`, while keeping the overlay visible if scene change fails
- `scripts/objects/enemy.gd` - generic-pool guard so specialized enemy projectile scenes bypass the bullet pool
- `Scripts/Projectiles/BreakerDetonation.cs` - C# breaker shrapnel pool fallback and atomic pooled-fragment activation
- `tests/unit/test_breaker_bullet.gd` - breaker cone, LOS, arming, pooled breaker, and C# helper regression coverage
- `tests/unit/test_projectile_pool_manager.gd` - pool ownership, duplicate-reference, parent-ownership, enemy scene guard, pooled breaker activation, and deferred collision-enable regression coverage
- `tests/unit/test_scene_loader.gd` - regression guards for exported-build scene fallback behavior
- `docs/case-studies/issue-1634/` - investigation notes, refreshed GitHub metadata, and preserved user logs from the issue/PR comments

## Latest update - Session 12

Addressed the April 18 follow-up report that the latest build still has no breaker shrapnel. The new user log is preserved at:

- `docs/case-studies/issue-1634/data/logs/game_log_20260418_023429.txt`

The log shows Breaker Bullets were selected and applied to `MakarovPM`/`AKGL`, then repeated `Bullet9mm` explosion sound events. That means detonation still works and the remaining failure is still in fragment visibility/collision/reuse after detonation.

Root cause addressed in this session: pooled breaker shrapnel now queues a final deferred collision-enable via `call_deferred("_queue_collision_enabled", true)` after activation. This makes activation win even when a previously returned fragment still has stale deferred collision-disable writes queued from the prior physics flush.

Also merged upstream `main` into this branch and resolved conflicts in `SceneLoader`/`test_scene_loader`, preserving both this PR's typed `ResourceLoader.load(path, "PackedScene")` export fallback and upstream's guard that keeps the loading overlay visible if sync scene change fails.

## Test plan

- [x] `dotnet build GodotTopDownTemplate.sln --configuration Debug` passed on head `5ce81c92` (`ci-logs/local-dotnet-build-merge-session12.log`) with existing warnings and 0 errors
- [x] `git diff --check` passed on head `5ce81c92` (`ci-logs/local-git-diff-check-merge-session12.log`)
- [x] Static regression coverage confirms C# `BreakerDetonation.SpawnShrapnel()` uses `ProjectilePoolManager.get_breaker_shrapnel()` and passes damage/speed during `pool_activate()`
- [x] Static regression coverage confirms specialized enemy projectile scenes bypass the generic bullet pool
- [x] Regression coverage added for `BreakerShrapnel.pool_activate()` applying damage and speed atomically
- [x] Regression coverage added for same-frame pool return/reuse preserving `monitoring` and `monitorable` after deferred writes flush
- [x] Regression coverage added for breaker shrapnel activation queueing the final collision-enable after stale deferred disables
- [ ] GitHub Actions on new head `5ce81c92` are in progress after push

## Local test limitations

This container does not have a local `godot` or `godot4` binary, so I could not rerun GUT locally. GitHub Actions should run the Godot import/test/export checks on the pushed head.

The local C# build exits with 0 errors.

## Fixes applied

**Root cause found and fixed.**

### Bug: premature detonation through walls

The cone check introduced in session 1 was missing a **line-of-sight check**. The function `_check_enemy_in_shrapnel_cone()` triggered detonation whenever an enemy was within 95px and within ±30° of the bullet direction — **even if a wall separated the bullet from the enemy**.

In typical levels, players are often in corridors adjacent to rooms with enemies. As soon as a breaker bullet was fired, the nearest enemy in the next room (within 95px through the wall) triggered the cone check, and the bullet detonated immediately. This is exactly the "bullets completely broken" behavior.

**Fix:** Added `_breaker_has_line_of_sight()` call before detonating in the cone check (GDScript `bullet.gd` + C# `BreakerDetonation.cs`). If a wall blocks the path between bullet and enemy, that enemy is skipped.

### Also: sensitivity sector widened to ±45°

Widened `BREAKER_SHRAPNEL_HALF_ANGLE` from **30°** to **45°** as requested. At 30° the fuse only triggers for nearly head-on enemies. At 45° the fuse covers a broader arc — shrapnel has a better chance to hit off-axis targets.

### Changes in this commit

- `scripts/projectiles/bullet.gd` — LOS check added, half-angle → 45°
- `Scripts/Projectiles/BreakerDetonation.cs` — same changes
- `tests/unit/test_breaker_bullet.gd` — updated angle values, 2 new LOS tests
- `docs/case-studies/issue-1634/README.md` — analysis of root cause and fix documented

## 🤖 Session 3 Fix: Arming Distance

**Root cause identified from game log (`game_log_20260330_124617.txt`):**

The enemy-cone proximity fuse had **no arming distance**. If an enemy was within 95px in the forward ±45° cone with clear line of sight at the moment of firing, the bullet detonated on the very first physics frame — at the muzzle, before traveling anywhere.

**Example:** Player stands 80px from an enemy and fires at them → bullet spawns 20px from the player → first physics frame check: enemy is 60px ahead, in the 45° cone, clear LOS → **immediate detonation**. The pistol appears "broken" — bullets disappear without reaching the enemy.

**Fix applied:**
- Added `BREAKER_ARMING_DISTANCE = 40.0px` — the enemy-cone check only activates after the bullet travels ≥40px from spawn
- Wall check still activates immediately (unchanged — a wall very close to the muzzle should still trigger)
- Applied to both `bullet.gd` (GDScript) and `BreakerDetonation.cs`/`Bullet.cs`/`ShotgunPellet.cs` (C#)

**Why 40px?** At bullet speed 2500px/s × 60fps ≈ 42px/frame. 40px ≈ 1 physics frame of travel — minimal safety margin, doesn't reduce effective range.

This matches real proximity fuse design: fuzes have an arming distance to prevent self-damage near the weapon.

Also fixed stale log messages that still said "60px" even after the 95px update.

## Session 4 Fix: PM Bullet Pool Interaction Bugs

Addressed the feedback about PM bullet pool still being broken. After deep root cause analysis, found **3 interconnected bugs** in the pool recycle path:

### Root Causes Found

**Bug 1 — Shrapnel scene cleared on pool reset, not reloaded**
- `_reset_state()` sets `_breaker_shrapnel_scene = null` (correct — cleanup)
- `_ready()` only runs once at scene tree add — does NOT run on pool reuse
- `set_is_breaker_bullet()` setter did NOT reload the scene for pooled bullets
- **Result**: Pooled breaker bullet has no shrapnel scene → detonation spawns nothing

**Bug 2 — Arming distance not reset on pool reuse**
- `_reset_state()` was missing `_breaker_distance_traveled = 0.0`
- A bullet that traveled >40px before being recycled would re-arm immediately on next fire
- **Result**: Instant enemy cone detonation on the first frame after spawn

**Bug 3 — Direct property assignment bypasses setter in player.gd**
- `bullet.is_breaker_bullet = true` (direct assignment in GDScript) does NOT call `set_is_breaker_bullet()`
- The setter is a separate function, not an auto-called setter in GDScript `var` declarations
- **Result**: Even with Bug 1 fix, the setter was never invoked from `player.gd`

### Why PM Specifically
PM bullets use `Instantiate<Node2D>()` for spawning (no pool → no Bug 1/2/3 at spawn time). BUT PM bullets ARE returned to the pool via `pool_deactivate()` when destroyed. When these recycled PM bullets are reassigned as breaker bullets, all 3 bugs manifest.

### Fixes Applied (commit `5c34f6fb`)
1. `set_is_breaker_bullet()` — now reloads `_breaker_shrapnel_scene` if null (for pooled reuse)
2. `_reset_state()` — added `_breaker_distance_traveled = 0.0`
3. `_breaker_spawn_shrapnel()` — changed early return guard: only blocks when BOTH scene AND pool manager are unavailable
4. `player.gd` — changed `bullet.is_breaker_bullet = true` → `bullet.call("set_is_breaker_bullet", true)` to invoke setter

### New Regression Tests
Added `MockPooledBreakerBullet` class + 3 tests in `tests/unit/test_breaker_bullet.gd`:
- `test_pool_bullet_reloads_shrapnel_scene` — verifies the fix works
- `test_pool_bullet_without_fix_cannot_spawn_shrapnel` — regression guard
- `test_pool_bullet_resets_arming_distance` — verifies distance resets to 0.0

commits.messageBody:
…ity fuse (Issue #1634)

The proximity fuse now detonates when an alive enemy enters the shrapnel cone sector
(±30° from bullet direction, within 95px range), not only when the bullet's straight
forward path is blocked by a wall or target directly in line.

Changes:
- bullet.gd: replaced single forward raycast enemy check with two-stage detection:
  1. Forward raycast for wall detection (unchanged, straight ahead only)
  2. New _check_enemy_in_shrapnel_cone(): group query + dot product geometry,
     detonates when any alive enemy is within BREAKER_DETONATION_DISTANCE AND
     within BREAKER_SHRAPNEL_HALF_ANGLE from bullet direction
- BreakerDetonation.cs: same two-stage logic with new CheckEnemyInShrapnelCone()
- test_breaker_bullet.gd: added 8 new cone sector detection tests covering in-cone,
  edge-angle, out-of-cone, too-far, behind, exact-distance, direction-agnostic cases
- docs/case-studies/issue-1634/README.md: case study with real-world proximity fuse
  analysis, solution options comparison, and performance notes

Optimization: uses dot product (no acos) and group query (no extra physics queries).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.messageBody:
Root cause of broken bullets: _check_enemy_in_shrapnel_cone() had no
line-of-sight check. Enemies behind walls within 95px could trigger
premature detonation, causing bullets to explode immediately after
firing in areas with adjacent rooms.

Fix: add _breaker_has_line_of_sight() call before detonating in the
cone check (GDScript + C# BreakerDetonation). Skip enemies blocked
by walls.

Also widen BREAKER_SHRAPNEL_HALF_ANGLE from 30° to 45° (as requested
in PR #1661 comment) so the fuse covers a broader arc and shrapnel
has a better chance to hit targets that are slightly off-axis.

Tests updated: cone edge test uses 45°, outside-cone test uses 60°,
two new tests for LOS behavior (blocked and clear).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

…tion on spawn

Root cause (session 3): the enemy-cone proximity fuse had no arming distance.
If an enemy was within 95px in the forward cone with clear LOS at fire time,
the bullet detonated on the very first physics frame (frame-zero detonation),
making breaker bullets appear completely broken for close-range combat.

Fix:
- Added BREAKER_ARMING_DISTANCE = 40.0px constant (≈ 1 physics frame of travel)
- The enemy-cone check is now gated: only runs after bullet travels ≥ 40px
- Wall check still activates immediately from spawn (unchanged)
- Added _breaker_distance_traveled tracking in bullet.gd physics_process
- Same fix applied to BreakerDetonation.cs (distanceTraveled param) and ShotgunPellet.cs

Also:
- Fixed stale log messages: '60px' → '95px with 40px arming distance'
- Updated active_item_manager.gd description to match actual behavior
- Added 4 new unit tests: arming distance constant, pre-arming no-detonate,
  post-arming detonate, wall-check-still-works-before-arming
- Updated case study README with session 3 root cause analysis

commits.messageBody:
…ing distance reset

Three bugs found when ProjectilePoolManager recycles a bullet for breaker use:

1. **Missing shrapnel on detonation**: pool_activate() → _reset_state() cleared
   _breaker_shrapnel_scene, then _ready() didn't run again on reused pool bullets.
   Fix: set_is_breaker_bullet() now reloads the shrapnel scene if it was cleared.

2. **Shrapnel early-return blocked pool path**: _breaker_spawn_shrapnel() returned
   early when _breaker_shrapnel_scene == null, blocking pool-based shrapnel too.
   Fix: only return early if BOTH scene is null AND pool manager is unavailable.

3. **Arming distance not reset**: _reset_state() did not reset _breaker_distance_traveled.
   Recycled bullets from a previous breaker use started already armed (≥40px traveled),
   bypassing frame-zero detonation protection. Fix: reset it to 0.0 in _reset_state().

Also: player.gd pooled path changed from direct `bullet.is_breaker_bullet = true`
assignment to `bullet.call("set_is_breaker_bullet", true)` so the setter (which
reloads the shrapnel scene) always runs for pooled bullets.

Adds 3 regression tests to test_breaker_bullet.gd covering pool interaction scenarios.
Updates case study README with Session 4 root cause analysis.
